The Simplera™ continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system helps people manage diabetes. The Simplera™ CGM uses an inserted Simplera™ sensor with Bluetooth™ wireless technology that converts small amounts of glucose from the interstitial fluid under the skin into an electronic signal. The Simplera™ sensor uses that signal to provide sensor glucose values to the Simplera™ system app on a compatible display device.

The Simplera™ app provides alerts based on sensor glucose (SG) levels and contains a user interface for entering data such as insulin, meals, exercise, blood glucose (BG) values, and uploading information to the CareLink™ Personal website. The Simplera™ app is available to download from the Apple® App Store™ and requires the Simplera™ sensor to function.

The Simplera™ CGM provides information that is used for diabetes management but does not provide any direct therapy. The Simplera™ CGM should only be used with supported mobile devices and operating systems. It is compatible with the Apple Watch™ which can display glucose values and receive system and SG alerts just like a mobile phone. In order to access the list of the supported mobile devices and operating systems, contact your local Medtronic representative. 

To use the Simplera™ CGM, you will need the Simplera™ sensor as well as this app.
